user.title: Who should we locate?
user.description: Choose an existing Home Assistant Person. A login is not required. Existing Person tracking and automations stay unchanged. Leave the name empty to use the person’s name.

device.title: Add or edit a tracked device
device.description: Name a logical phone, watch, tablet or tag. Its GPS, room and charging sources may come from different integrations. Type alone never proves that a watch is worn.

settings.description: Changes apply after Save and reload this integration entry.

source_mode.title: Choose source selection
source_mode.description: Filtered sources show recognized capabilities. Use advanced manual mapping for unsupported providers or to repair renamed sources. Suggested mappings must be confirmed.

sources.title: Choose this device’s sources

data_description.tracker: Use a position-capable tracker. Old observations remain old even when the entity updates.
data_description.room: Choose a room/area string sensor, not a distance, temperature or battery level.
data_description.charging: Choose Charging/Not Charging or a charging binary sensor; numeric battery level is unsuitable.
data_description.worn: Use a real on-body or worn signal. Without one, a watch left on a table can remain selected.
data_description.local_tracker: Recommended for Bluetooth room inference; it must belong to the same physical device.
data_description.timestamp_entity: Optional override for an actual observation time; time-of-day alone is not sufficient.
data_description.timestamp_attribute: Use a full-date timestamp attribute such as last_located, not a display-only clock value.

rules.title: Set preference and eligibility
rules.description: Lower preference numbers are considered first; confirmed worn evidence takes precedence. Charging phones may still be carried in cars or pockets. Only exclude them when that matches your use. Charging has a separate age limit: iCloud3 defaults are 30 minutes for wearables and 150 minutes for other devices, or the shared limit if longer. Other providers use the shared limit. Enable custom charging status age to use the number below; leave it off to follow the provider default. Turning it off again removes a saved override. Longer windows tolerate delayed reports but take longer to expire if a provider stops updating. Wearing and location limits are unchanged.

data.use_custom_charging_age: Use a custom charging status age

lookup_provider.title: Address lookup service
lookup_provider.description: Geoapify needs only your own API key. Custom service is an advanced option. Removing the shared service stops lookup for everyone; it does not remove location history.

lookup_geoapify.title: Geoapify API key

data.remove_key: Remove saved key and household service

lookup_test.title: Check the connection (optional)
lookup_test.description: Testing sends one fixed public example coordinate, not anyone’s location, and may use one Geoapify credit. Nothing is saved or enabled by this test. You can skip and save for later.

lookup_test_success.title: Connection successful
lookup_test_success.description: The service returned a valid result. Continue, then use the final Save to apply your settings.

lookup_test_error.title: Connection could not be checked
lookup_test_error.description:
{reason}

No settings have been saved. You can change the key, retry, or skip the test.

lookup_custom.title: Advanced: custom service
lookup_custom.description: Use an authorized or self-hosted Nominatim-compatible reverse endpoint. Public OSMF Nominatim is unsupported. This is optional; Geoapify needs none of these settings. Changes apply only after final Save.

data.authorized: I am authorized to use this service for automated lookup
data.local_http: Allow HTTP for a local self-hosted service

missing_sources.title: Person Presence source needs attention
missing_sources.description:
These configured source entities are missing: {sources}.

[Configure Person Presence](/config/integrations/integration/person_presence) and edit the affected device mappings. Existing settings are retained. Temporary stale GPS and normal away Bluetooth are not configuration repairs.

clear_place_cache.name: Clear place cache
clear_place_cache.description: Deletes cached external place descriptions for all people. Does not delete dashboard last-known history. Requires an administrator.
